sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def do_diff(label):
    b = [r.ljust(64,'.') for r in previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
    c = [r.ljust(64,'.') for r in current_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
    diffs = [(r,col,b[r][col],c[r][col]) for r in range(len(c)) for col in range(len(c[r])) if b[r][col]!=c[r][col]]
    non_timer = [d for d in diffs if d[0]!=1]
    print(label, "non-timer diffs:", non_timer[:30])
    return non_timer

for (r,c) in [(50,36),(49,40),(55,33),(55,39),(51,36)]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    do_diff(f"click ({r},{c})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def do_diff(label):
    b = [r.ljust(64,'.') for r in previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
    c = [r.ljust(64,'.') for r in current_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
    diffs = [(r,col,b[r][col],c[r][col]) for r in range(len(c)) for col in range(len(c[r])) if b[r][col]!=c[r][col]]
    non_timer = [d for d in diffs if d[0]!=1]
    print(label, "non-timer diffs:", non_timer[:30])
    return non_timer
